messages.subject: Marldale Aggregates v Crayford Plant Engineering - Protocol response
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

We are instructed by Crayford Plant Engineering Limited. We will respond substantively to your Letter of Claim within the protocol period. Our client's position is that there is no breach: the throughput shortfall and the component failures are attributable to out-of-specification feed material and to your client's operation and maintenance of the plant. Our client also has a counterclaim for the unpaid retention of £142,500.

We suggest the parties agree a single joint expert in due course.

Alistair Whitlock
Partner, Pemberton Rowe LLP

messages.subject: RE: Marldale Aggregates v Crayford Plant Engineering - Protocol response
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

Thank you. We note your client's position is denied and we look forward to the substantive response. We agree in principle to a single joint expert on the engineering causation issues, subject to terms of reference. On the retention, our client withheld it precisely because of the defects; it will be addressed in any global resolution.

Kind regards

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Litigation
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 5500

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
